programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: The fun never stops in New Orleans.This dancing city is, above all, the cradle of jazz - music resounds here from morning to evening, creating an amazing atmosphere, and artists from all over the world hang out in cafes and pubs.Colorful buildings and narrow streets give the city a unique character and thus become an attractive setting for film productions.There is also no shortage of different colors on Frenchmen Street, where Marcin can try on an original suit.Also expect a bit of poetry on the way to Miami!However, before we get there, Marcin will have to find his black, mechanical horse...

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: This time Marcin Prokop visits the furthest reaches of the United States: Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.What distinguishes them from the rest of the country is not only their location, but also cultural gaps and different mentalities.In the frosty corners of the North, local inhabitants, like their ancestors, live in rhythm with the seasons and in harmony with nature.Their lives often take place in one apartment building, which serves as a city.In Hawaii, in the heart of commercial tourism, local dance masters are trying to pass on to young generations a philosophy of life consistent with the spirit of aloha.It is also a paradise for the development of spiritual and artistic communities who try to live outside the system, in harmony with nature and according to their own rules.However, Puerto Rico, a Caribbean island devastated by a hurricane, formally belongs to the US, but is neither a country nor a state.Its inhabitants fight for their independence and the right to self-determination.They create grassroots resistance movements, alternative communities, ecovillages and new ways of life, cultivating ancestral history and local pride Marcin continues his expedition in Alaska, visiting places where the descendants of Inuit and Russians still fight to preserve their identity.In the tiny village of Ninilchik and the town of Eklutna, he meets residents who cultivate the memory of their ancestors in everyday gestures and religion.He also learns about the history of the Dena'ina tribe, which combines the tradition of building "soul houses" with Orthodox heritage.In Anchorage, Marcin participates in folk dance workshops, where various ethnic groups try to renew ancient rituals and save their culture from oblivion.The entire journey is a story about the lives and traditions of people who rely on the harsh Alaskan nature and who constantly care for their unique cultural identity.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
